settings.text:
We gift-wrap each order at no extra cost. Add a printed message at checkout — a real note, not a slip of paper.

The invoice in the box shows no prices, so the gift lands exactly as it should.

settings.question: I don't know which scent he would prefer — what should I do?
settings.answer: The Discovery Set is made for exactly this. It contains a sample of every perfume in the collection so he can wear each one before choosing his favourite. It also includes a credit toward his first full bottle, so nothing goes to waste.

settings.question: Do you gift-wrap orders?
settings.answer: Yes — every order is gift-wrapped at no extra cost. You can add a personal message at checkout and it will be printed on a card included in the box. The invoice shows no prices.

settings.question: What if he already has it, or it is not the right fit?
settings.answer: If the bottle arrives unopened, please get in touch and we will sort it out. Opened perfume cannot be returned for hygiene reasons — which is why we always suggest the Discovery Set for anyone who hasn't chosen a scent yet.
